title: Soggy Sparkler Shed Cake
tagline: Layers of limp wrappers, shed-floor crumb and a very confident slime glaze.
time: 1 hour of stirring, 1 week of regret
steps: Line the cauldron with the drowned wrappers, flat, / then slap on the trainer and sit on it. Splat!
Drop in the odd sock, give it a good thump, / then bury it deep in a sawdust lump.
Crumble the flowerpot, terracotta and cracked, / and sprinkle it over till the whole thing's stacked.
Pull on the gloves and give twine a good twist, / then knot it in a bow with a flick of the wrist.
Pour the slime over, let it drip down the side, / then wobble it out with a witch's great pride.
rhyme:
Hop and stir the cauldron round,
In go wrappers, soggy, drowned!
Plop goes a trainer, left and grey,
Then one odd sock to join the fray.
Sprinkle sawdust from the shed,
Crumbled flowerpot, brick-red.
Squelch the gloves and twine in a knot,
Lime-green slime, a gloopy lot!
Stir it thrice and stack it tall,
The wobbliest wreck of a cake of all!
image_prompt: A tall, lopsided cake on a chipped plate, built from layers of soggy grey cardboard tubes and a squashed old trainer sole, with sawdust crumbs and crushed terracotta on top. Bright lime-green slime drips down the sides. A tangled green twine bow sits at the top, with a few limp empty tubes poking out like candles.
alt_text: A leaning cake of soggy cardboard tubes, an old trainer and sawdust, covered in dripping green slime and topped with a twine bow.
caption_hook: Today's pudding comes straight from the back of the shed, with a slime glaze and a generous slice of nope. Who's bringing this to the bonfire picnic?
